transport_behavior: Original frozen generate() still chooses prompts, generation parameters, token recovery and response acceptance.
One local SQLite limiter coordinates all campaign processes by project, region and model.
Every real API outcome passes through the original raw observer before outage handling.
Open capacity circuit creates a shared persistent campaign stop; no autonomous restart or timed probe.
On stop, queued jobs are cancelled and already accepted results remain intact; in-flight successful responses are retained.
Unfinished work resumes only after a further user instruction; no accepted response is regenerated.
Transport jitter does not consume simulation RNG; the original provider retry code retains its original random behavior.
Permanent provider errors and exhausted transient retry budgets also pause the campaign; historical runtime-invalid observations are preserved.
amendment.reporting_requirement: Report the operational change and preserved historical runtime-invalid results. Do not treat improved request completion after the change as a clinical or architectural effect.
